-- There are 4 months of data, and we exclude the first month, so we should have 3 rows.

WITH month_boundaries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_1st
    FROM customer_transactions
    ORDER BY 1
),
customer_txn_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
        customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                 ELSE 0 END) as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.month_1st,
        c.customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(c2.net_amount), 0) as cumulative_balance
    FROM month_boundaries mb
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c
    LEFT JOIN customer_txn_balance c2 ON c2.customer_id = c.customer_id 
        AND c2.txn_date <= mb.month_1st
    GROUP BY mb.month_1st, c.customer_id
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        month_1st,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cumulative_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE cumulative_balance END) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
    GROUP BY month_1st
)
SELECT 
    month_1st as month,
    total_balance
FROM monthly_totals
WHERE month_1st > (SELECT MIN(month_1st) FROM monthly_totals)
ORDER BY month_1st
